title: Roasted Squash Seeds
preamble:
Ingredients:-
1
c. raw winter squash seeds
1
olive oil
1/2
teaspoon chili powder
1/2
teaspoon coriander powder
1/2
teaspoon salt
1/4
teaspoon cumin powder
1/8
teaspoon cinnamon powder

1
c. raw winter squash seeds
1
olive oil
1/2
teaspoon chili powder
1/2
teaspoon coriander powder
1/2
teaspoon salt
1/4
teaspoon cumin powder
1/8
teaspoon cinnamon powder

Method:-
Heat oven to Gas Mark 2 or use bottom of a hotter oven.
Oil a baking tray.
Toss with oil and seasonings, then spread evenly in a baking tray, no more than one seed deep
Bake uncovered, stirring every 15 minutes for 40-50 minutes until seeds are dry but not yet browned. Store in airtight container for up to a month.
